Setting the Stage As part of the Innovative Solutions Lab Workshop at the 2025 Better Buildings Summit1, an activity was developed to engage attendees in an interactive educational experience. Through collaborative problem-solving and creative thinking, attendees gained valuable insights and practical strategies for saving energy in commercial buildings. Participants worked together to devise innovative solutions to the challenges faced in implementing energy initiatives in various sectors. The effort was designed to provide Better Buildings Partners, who are typically building owners and operators, a platform to learn how to make decisions about energy upgrades that could be implemented in existing buildings to help them meet their Better Buildings goals2. The workshop attendees were divided into groups of 6 to 8 participants. Each group pretended to be an owner team that was considering strategies for retrofitting an existing building. The current condition of this hypothetical building was known, and a handout was provided with this building assessment (1.1 Activity Overview). After review, the workshop teams completed the Overview Table (1.3 Overview Table). Based on the discussion, the workshop team evaluated options for improving the building (1.1 Game Cards). Once options were selected, the team completed the Energy Savings Table (1.5). Outline of Supporting Materials To document and replicate this workshop activity, the materials have been packaged into this publication so others can benefit from this activity. Individuals or organizations interested in conducting this activity with their stakeholders can use the supporting materials attached in Sections 1.1 through 1.6: - 1.1 Activity Overview provides contextual information for the activity, including the details of the example building, baseline energy use, and instructions for conducting the activity. - 1.2 Sample Facilitation Guide includes a “run of show” that was used for the original iteration of this workshop activity at the 2025 Better Buildings Summit, as well as descriptions of the facilitator roles. - 1.3 Overview Table is a blank template to be completed by activity participants. This is used to document decisions during the activity and can also serve as a summary report once it is complete. - 1.4 Game Cards can be printed or used electronically for the activity.
